@/lib/teslaAuthRecovery notifyTeslaAuthRecovered (L13,52) -> the web impl dispatches a DOM 'teslasync:tesla-auth-recovered' CustomEvent on document; React Native has no DOM (tsconfig lib has no 'dom'). The component subscribes to both events on mount (L36-37) and unsubscribes on cleanup (L38-41), mirroring document.addEventListener/removeEventListener. No native surface emits 'expired' yet, so pillDisconnected only clears on a recovery edge -- the explicit native-unavailable state.
